messages:
Sam: Heads-up — seeing a big fanout to PagerDuty after a Redis cache thump at 16:12 UTC. Inference nodes spiking cache-miss alerts and oncall is getting flooded.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: redis-cache-thump — PagerDuty alerts triggered (service: redis-cache-service). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345
Aisha: Taking this. Quick ask: can we temporarily quiet PD escalation for `inference-cache-miss-high` while we investigate?
Kai: +1 to quieting. Proposal: group by `cluster`, set dedupe/window to 5m, and rate-limit to 1/min per service. That should collapse the fanout.
Maya: Sounds good. Also please add a dashboard card showing unique affected customers vs host count — helps scope customer impact.
Sam: I'll do a temporary PD mute: `/pd mute redis-cache-service 15m` so pages stop firing while we apply grouping.
Ops-Tooling-Bot: Command received: scheduled PD mute for `redis-cache-service` for 15 minutes. Muted incidents: 3.
Aisha: After mute — add an Alertmanager suppression: `if alert == inference-cache-miss-high then group_by: [cluster]` and `group_interval: 300s`. Keeps signal but reduces noise.
Kai: Opening a quick PR for alerting config with the live-mitigation comment. PR: https://git.example/r/alerting/+/1234 — will include rate limit and grouping keys.
Maya: Initial customer impact check: error-rate stable at 0%, latency up ~8% for cold-start paths. Not seeing user-facing errors yet. Pinged CS just in case.
Sam: Handing off the post-mitigation tasks to @Aisha — please track: revert mute, persist or rollback config change, and create dashboard card.
Aisha: Plan: 1) keep suppression for 30m, 2) add dashboard tile (unique_customers vs hosts), 3) add runbook note under INCIDENT-12345, 4) follow up in 2h to either revert or make change permanent. :thumbsup:
Kai: PR merged to staging and rolling to prod canary (10%). Will monitor logs for regressions, revert if we see increased errors.
Maya: Adding likely affected tenants to incident notes: app-alpha, analytics-pipeline. No SEV emails yet.
Sam: Thanks — once this stabilizes I'll create a post-incident writeup with recommended permanent mitigations: dedupe/grouping keys, rate limits, and a detector for cache-eviction storms.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status -> monitoring. Mitigation applied: PD mute + alert grouping. Notifying PagerDuty and incident channel.
